name: export_model_to_rhino
author: hprebar
title: Plan Rhino 3DM Layer Hierarchy from Revit Model
description: Plan Rhino 3DM layer hierarchy structure based on Revit categories and levels without writing 3DM files to disk.
notes: Generates target layer naming, hierarchy, RGB colors, scale factors, and element counts for Rhino 3DM export planning.

categories.description: List of Revit BuiltInCategory names to export.

targetRhinoUnits.description: Target Rhino document unit system (Meters, Millimeters, Feet).

groupByLevel.description: Whether to nest layers under Level parents.
